title: The Ancient Machine That Shouldn't Exist

characters.name: The Sponge Diver
characters.locked_description: a Greek sponge diver of 1900 in a heavy patched canvas diving suit, a round copper helmet with three small glass portholes, lead-weighted boots, a thick black air hose and a rope line trailing upward

characters.name: Valerios Stais
characters.locked_description: a Greek archaeologist of about forty in 1902, neatly parted dark hair, a full dark moustache, round wire spectacles, a dark wool three-piece suit and a white high-collared shirt

locations.name: The Antikythera Wreck
locations.locked_description: a steep slope of grey sand and pale rock deep under blue-green water, the scattered timber ribs of an ancient hull, broken amphorae half-buried in sand, bronze and marble statues lying among the stones

locations.name: The Athens Museum Workroom
locations.locked_description: a workroom of the National Archaeological Museum in Athens around 1902, tall shuttered windows, long wooden tables covered with shipwreck finds in labelled trays, glass display cases and plain plaster walls

key_props.name: The Sponge Boat
key_props.locked_description: a small Greek sponge-diving boat of 1900, a single-masted wooden caïque with a high curved prow, a patched canvas sail, a hand-cranked brass air pump on deck and coils of rope

key_props.name: The Fragment
key_props.locked_description: the main Antikythera fragment, a flat slab of green-brown corroded bronze about the size of a hand, crusted like stone, a large four-spoked gear wheel with fine triangular teeth emerging from its surface

key_props.name: The Mechanism, Restored
key_props.locked_description: the Antikythera mechanism as it looked when new, a wooden case the size of a shoebox with a bright bronze front plate, engraved zodiac and calendar rings, slender bronze pointers and a hand crank on one side
